  name: text("name").notNull(),
  type: text("type").notNull().default("checking"),

export const balanceSnapshots = pgTable("balance_snapshots", {
  id: uuid("id").defaultRandom().primaryKey(),
  workspaceId: uuid("workspace_id").notNull().references(() => workspaces.id),
  accountId: uuid("account_id").notNull().references(() => accounts.id),
  amountMinor: bigint("amount_minor", { mode: "bigint" }).notNull(),
  currencyCode: text("currency_code").notNull(),
  asOf: timestamp("as_of", { withTimezone: true }).notNull(),

  boundaryKind: text("boundary_kind").notNull().default("date_only"),
  sourceTransactionId: uuid("source_transaction_id").references((): AnyPgColumn => sourceTransactions.id),
  coveredTransactions: jsonb("covered_transactions"),
  actorId: uuid("actor_id").references(() => authUsers.id),
  commandInput: jsonb("command_input"),
  version: integer("version").notNull().default(1),
  undoneAt: timestamp("undone_at", { withTimezone: true }),

]);

questions.question: When you tell the chat to do something (add an expense, accept agent findings), how should it be confirmed?

options.label: Always a Yes card (Recommended)
options.description: Chat never changes data by itself. It shows a card (single or 'Accept all 5') and nothing happens until you press Yes. Same as the loan cards today; safest against AI mistakes.

options.label: Direct when explicit
options.description: If you clearly say 'accept them all', it applies immediately and replies with an Undo link. Faster, but an AI misread changes data without a click.

questions.question: What should happen to a photo or PDF you attach?

options.label: Keep as receipt (Recommended)
options.description: Stored privately, shown in the chat message, and linked to the transaction it created so you can open the receipt from Transactions later.

options.label: Keep in chat only
options.description: Stored and visible in the chat history, but not linked to transactions.

options.label: Read once, then discard
options.description: The AI reads it, and only your text plus a short description of the file ('Receipt: Rewe, €23.40') is saved. Simplest, no file storage.

questions.question: When you say 'spent €10 on coffee' without naming an account, which account should the card use?

options.label: Cash, changeable (Recommended)
options.description: Card pre-selects your Cash account (created on first use if missing) with a dropdown to switch accounts before pressing Yes. If you say 'on my card', the AI picks that account.

options.label: Always ask
options.description: Card has no account chosen; you must pick one every time.

options.label: Last used account
options.description: Pre-selects whatever account you used last time in chat.

questions.question: For agent-team findings, what should 'mark as watched' mean?

options.label: Same as Accept (Recommended)
options.description: Use existing states only: Accept (applies the change, or for findings marks them acknowledged) and Dismiss. 'Watched' = acknowledged. No new status.

options.label: New 'Watching' status
options.description: Add a third decision: keep the finding open and flagged as watched on the Agent team page without applying or dismissing it. Needs a schema migration.
